import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Columns and their target dtypes as per target schema
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns (they are same in this case)
        # Convert columns to target dtypes
        for col in target_columns:
            if col in df.columns:
                # For string columns, convert to string dtype explicitly
                if dtype_map[col] == 'string':
                    df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
                else:
                    # Use pandas nullable integer dtype for integer columns to allow NaNs if any
                    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype_map[col])
            else:
                # If any column missing (not expected here), create with NaNs
                df[col] = pd.NA
                df[col] = df[col].astype(dtype_map[col])
        # Keep only target columns in correct order
        df = df[target_columns]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have exactly the same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) them directly
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Final type enforcement (in case concat caused any dtype changes)
    for col in target_columns:
        if dtype_map[col] == 'string':
            target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype('string')
        else:
            target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype_map[col])

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
